description: This file is a React component written in TypeScript that manages model group alias settings, including adding, editing, deleting, and displaying aliases, along with network interactions for saving configurations.

methods.name: saveAliasesToBackend
methods.description: Asynchronously saves the updated list of aliases to the backend via setCallbacksCall and updates parent components if necessary.

methods.name: handleAddAlias
methods.description: Handles adding a new alias, validates input, updates state, and persists to backend.

methods.name: handleEditAlias
methods.description: Sets the alias currently being edited.

methods.name: handleUpdateAlias
methods.description: Validates and saves updates to an existing alias, updating state and backend.

methods.name: deleteAlias
methods.description: Removes an alias by id, updates state and persists the change to backend.
